# Comfy SCAIL-2 Int8- Character Replacement

Animate a reference character using a driving video or replace characters entirely with SCAIL-2 Int8, which delivers higher quality than fp8 while running faster. The workflow accepts one reference image and one driving video, outputting an animated character sequence with replaced identity. Ideal for cross-identity character swaps, animal-driven animation, and multi-character scenes without intermediate pose representations. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs a COMFY_API_KEY.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/video_wan21_scail2_character_replacement_int8.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.text: A young East Asian woman with dark hair neatly pulled back, wearing a white sleeveless ribbed mock-neck top, is standing in a lush apple orchard. She holds a large glossy red apple with both hands, using a white paper handkerchief to wipe and clean the apple before smelling and eating it with her eyes closed and a blissful expression. Ripe red and yellow apples hang from leafy branches in the foreground, with rows of green apple trees softly blurred in the background under natural daylight.
